edit.empty.noBaseText:
Use [Open base image] to pick an image of the part to check.
ROIs are drawn on this image.
edit.empty.noProjectText: Create one with [New] above, or open a saved project with [Open].
edit.noSelection.pick:
Pick a check in the list on the left
to edit its ROI and judgment values here.
edit.noSelection.noChecks:
No checks.
Add a check with [Add] on the left.
For the part position, add 'Blob alignment' first.
edit.hint.noBase: Next: pick a base image with [Base image] (teaching · running come after that)
edit.hint.noChecks: Next: add a check with [Add] on the left
edit.hint.teach: Next: save the part's base position with [Teach base]
edit.hint.pick: Next: pick a check in the list on the left
edit.hint.result: Showing the result — changing a value clears it
edit.hint.draw: Drag on the image to draw the ROI, then check the base image result with [Run]
edit.defectFolder.none: No defect folder — subfolders: good (good parts) · one folder per defect type
edit.defect.noModelNoPython: No model — training needs [Set up Python] first (or [Import ONNX])
edit.role.reasonText: Runs only on NG and adds a reason. It never turns OK into NG
edit.role.judgeText: If this check is NG, the result is NG
edit.calibration.notNumber: Not a number: {0} (e.g. 0.05; leave empty for no calibration)
edit.lastRun.none: Not run yet — [Run] or [Run another image]
edit.goodFolder.none: No good folder — every image directly in the folder must be a good part
edit.goodRoi.rect: Region: {0:0},{1:0}  {2:0}×{3:0}  (drag on the image to change)
edit.goodRoi.whole: Region: whole image  (drag on the image to narrow)
edit.good.stale: Train again — the alignment · base position · region changed after training
edit.good.learned: Trained: {0} images learned · {1} for calibration · limit {2} · {3:0} ms per image
edit.modelHint.training: Training — when it finishes, check with [Run] or a test
edit.modelHint.folder: Next: pick a folder that holds only good images with [Good folder]
edit.modelHint.region: Next: drag on the image to set a region around the part only, then [Train] (with the whole image, small defects are easy to miss)
edit.modelHint.done: The good-part model judges. Standard checks set to 'Reason' only add a reason on NG
edit.lastRun.stale: The project changed, so the previous result was cleared — run again
edit.name: Name
edit.defectProbHelp: NG above this value (0~1). The NG code is the most likely defect name
